description: Patients who never have an examination with ANA pattern S.

a.request: For patients none of whose examination records has an `ANA Pattern` of 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as avg_aCL_IgM FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: Patients who never have an examination with ANA pattern equal to 'S'.
b.sql: SELECT p.ID FROM Patient p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S')
b.raw: Patients who never have an examination with ANA pattern equal to 'S'.

c.request: Among patients whose examinations don't show an `ANA Pattern` of 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10. Patients who never have an examination with ANA pattern S.
c.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: Patients with no examination record where ANA Pattern equals 'S', showing ID, sex, and the mean aCL IgM across all their examinations, ordered by mean aCL IgM descending with nulls last, limited to top 10 results.
d.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as mean_aCL_IgM FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY mean_aCL_IgM IS NULL, mean_aCL_IgM DESC LIMIT 10
